Surendra vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 June, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:101981
Court No. - 80
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 1068 of 2024
Applicant :- Surendra

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Dilip Kumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the court
concerned to decide the proceedings of the Case No. 559 of 2022 arising out of case crime no. 315/
2021 under Sections 498A, 323 Ipc and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kerakat, District- Jaunpur
pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-III, Jaunpur expeditiously within a
stipulated period.

entities.text: D.P. Act, Police Station Kerakat, District- Jaunpur
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in the said complaint case summoning order was passed against the accused persons in the year 2022.
It is further submitted that some of the accused persons have appeared but still the matter is pending at the stage of appearance of the accused persons as rest of the accused persons are absconding.
It is further submitted that the Court concerned is not taking proper interest in disposal of the said case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. I have considered the submissions and perused the entire record.
6. It reflects from the perusal of the order sheets that the aforesaid case is pending at the stage of appearance of some of the accused persons.

The trial court is expected to invoke its power provided under CrPC to ensure service of process upon the accused persons, which is sent under its seal and order in order to procure the presence of the accused.

7. In the circumstances, the Court concerned is directed to take all possible measures to procure the presence of the accused persons by sending appropriate process to them and to ensure the actual compliance by the office of its own orders within six months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it and thereafter all endeavours shall be made by it for expeditious disposal of the case, if there is no legal impediment.
8.

It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9. With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
Order Date :- 5.6.2024 Fhd  Surendra vs State Of U.P. And Another on 5 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96835391/
